children: On September 11, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after 30 consecutive business days below the threshold. Trading continues on Nasdaq under SDST, and the company has 180 days until March 10, 2027 to regain compliance (including via a reverse split if needed); it also previously received notice of noncompliance with the $35 million market value of listed securities requirement, with a deadline of October 21, 2026.
